counts.unique_holdout_matches_note: 1069unique matches reused by2base model families and3maps; not6414independent matches.

source_reading.scope: Selected Example1/Table1 physicalpages3-4,sections3.1-3.2 and4.1-4.4 physicalpages4-7. Read equations4-7 and asymptotic-vs-finite-sample qualification; no supplement/proof/experimental reproduction.

limits: All forecasts reused from frozen historical calibration report; no training, recalibration or selection.
Joint total variation, averaged classwise ECE and top-label ECE condition on different information and have different scales; do not rank them against one another.
Binning bias and finite-sample variability remain. Fine partitions can inflate empirical error through noise; these are descriptive diagnostics, not population calibration certificates or p-values.
Nearest prediction-only cumulative cuts and symmetric cube-grid simplex cells are local adaptations. No claim to reproduce original binning, experiments or hypothesis tests.
Small-cell suppression affects charts/tables only; every occupied cell contributes to aggregate ECE. No individual forecasts/labels/IDs in public output.
This study does not fit a diagnostic map, replace production models or refresh data.

numeric.method: Independent Python dictionaries, math.fsum, cumulative cut enumeration and scalar TV/gaps; no native partition or summary helpers.
numeric.scope: 30frozen maps x3resolutions; all occupied bins contribute, visible cell means/counts reconciled. Shared _metrics used only to verify legacy report equality, not as numerical oracle.
numeric.figure_revision_scope: Only renderer spacing/tick text changed; all90diagnostic results, source forecasts and configs compare exactly to independently audited initial run.

full_suite.scope: Final computational/CLI/test sources; subsequent figure-only spacing/tick revision verified by actual rendering with diagnostic results exactly unchanged.

verification.test_scope: Two consolidated cases in existing test_experiments: published six-vector counterexample, joint class permutation, display-only suppression, nested-grid refinement, scalar-metric equivalence, equal-mass tie/order invariance, frozen inputs, invalid probabilities and atomic CLI output rejection for duplicate/empty byte names.

cli.result: Actual fixed-data CLI,3PL-XGBoost maps, matches all diagnostic study fields exactly. Unicode model names only; no pickle loading.

independent_review.status: Source and final artifact reviews passed after fixing empty bytes model names; no unresolved findings.
independent_review.scope: Numerical definitions, class-permutation and scalar checks, tie-preserving cuts, display suppression, selection isolation and CLI atomic output; then corrected PNG/SVG layout, public report/table equality, denominators, privacy and source-reading limits. No duplicate full suite/study or main DB access.

visual.result: PNG rendered and inspected; fixed header overlap, left axis clipping and rounded half-point ticks, then inspected corrected figure. PNG/PDF remain private; SVG is public.

verification.prose: Chinese humanizer-zh and English stop-slop. Offline Harper found10 suggestions in the added English section: fixed one serial comma; retained technical names/terms, predeclared and the project sentence-case heading style.
